verdict.rationale: The evidence shows a Cake MCP integration that is 'All read-only', but that is a fixed property of the integration. Nothing documents issuing scoped or least-privilege API keys or tokens for an agent. Admin visibility controls apply to human stakeholder portals, and 2FA is an adjacent security control, so neither counts as agent credential scoping.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
